mediaError.insecure: Camera and microphone are unavailable. Open the site over HTTPS or in a modern browser.
mediaError.denied: Access to camera and microphone was denied. Allow access in your browser settings.
mediaError.inuse: A device is in use by another application. Close it and try again.

video.metaDescription: Random video calls with people from all over the world. Turn on your camera, filter by interests, and meet someone in one click.

voice.metaDescription: Voice conversations with random partners — no camera. Crisp audio, a live equalizer, and an instant connect.

screening.hiddenDescription: Inappropriate content detected. Your video is hidden from your partner.

errors.signInToStart: Sign in to your account to start chatting.

wsError.slowDownDescription: You're switching too quickly. Give it a second and keep going.
wsError.rate_limitedDescription: Too many actions in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
wsError.too_many_connectionsDescription: Too many tabs or devices are open. Close some and try again.
wsError.forbiddenDescription: This action isn't available right now.
wsError.bannedDescription: Your account is banned, so chatting is unavailable.

idle.video: Press “Start” — we'll ask for camera and microphone access and find you a partner.
idle.voice: Press “Start” — we'll ask for microphone access and find you a partner.

searching.title: Looking for a partner…
searching.longWait: It's quiet in the stream right now. Try easing your filters — you'll match faster.
searching.default: This will take a couple of seconds.

reconnecting.title: Restoring the connection…

reconnecting.first: The connection dropped. Trying to restore it — please keep this window open.
